articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video with a 1-million-token context window. Benchmarks show significant improvements in long-horizon planning and multi-step mathematical proof generation, narrowing the gap with domain-specific expert systems. The model also introduces a refined reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) pipeline that substantially reduces hallucination rates.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on ARC-AGI-2 Benchmark
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has set a new record on the ARC-AGI-2 abstract reasoning benchmark, scoring 91.4% — a task suite specifically designed to resist brute-force memorization. The result reignites debate about whether frontier LLMs are developing genuine compositional generalization or leveraging increasingly sophisticated pattern matching. Researchers noted the model's novel test-time compute scaling strategy as a key architectural innovation.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered pilot deployment at select BMW manufacturing plants and Amazon fulfillment centers, handling bin picking, parts transfer, and light assembly tasks. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded dexterous hands with 24 degrees of freedom and an on-board vision-language model for real-time task instruction. Early reports suggest 40% higher throughput than the Gen 2 prototype but highlight challenges in unstructured edge-case handling.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Saudi Arabia's PIF, valuing the company at $18 billion. The funding will go toward building a dedicated humanoid robot factory in Texas with a target capacity of 10,000 units per year by 2028. Figure's robots use a foundation model co-developed with OpenAI for generalized manipulation, and the company says it already has binding purchase agreements from three Fortune 100 logistics companies.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Guardrails as an Open Standard for Enterprise Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic published an open specification for Constitutional AI (CAI) guardrails, providing enterprises with a standardized framework for constraining model behavior within auditable policy boundaries. The spec includes formal verification hooks, red-team test suites, and integrations with SOC 2 and ISO 42001 compliance workflows. Several major cloud providers, including AWS and Azure, have announced day-one support for the standard in their managed AI services.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has commenced risk production on its N1.4 process node using next-generation gate-all-around (GAA) transistor architecture at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of its original timeline. The node promises a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over N2, targeting high-performance AI accelerator and data center SoC designs. Apple, Nvidia, and AMD are reported to be among the first customers with tape-out slots reserved for mid-2027.

articles.title: MIT and Boston Dynamics Demonstrate Learned Parkour for Quadrupeds in Unstructured Outdoor Terrain
articles.summary: A joint MIT CSAIL and Boston Dynamics research team published results showing the Spot robot performing dynamic parkour maneuvers — including precision jumps, wall runs, and gap traversals — in fully unstructured outdoor environments using a sim-to-real reinforcement learning pipeline. The system requires no pre-mapped terrain data and adapts in real time using proprioceptive and depth sensing feedback. The work advances the state of the art in agile legged locomotion and has implications for search-and-rescue and defense applications.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Wave of High-Risk System Audits Across Financial Sector
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act, targeting high-risk AI systems deployed in credit scoring, insurance underwriting, and fraud detection by major European banks. Regulators are examining algorithmic transparency documentation, bias testing records, and human oversight mechanisms. The enforcement action is being closely watched globally as a potential template for AI governance, with several non-EU jurisdictions signaling intent to adopt similar frameworks.
